delta.finding: The pre-existing FREE admission boundary suite relied on concrete HTTP/wrapper mocks for network observation. A provider or catalog path using a different stdlib socket route could therefore evade the test instrumentation while violating the intended zero-network-before-admission invariant.
delta.repair: Add a wrapper-independent stdlib socket tripwire covering socket.create_connection, socket.getaddrinfo, socket.socket.connect and socket.socket.connect_ex, and exercise blocked UNKNOWN/PAID/SUBSCRIPTION base-controller cases, blocked catalog discovery and blocked OpenRouter distillery behavior without relying on the corresponding request-wrapper mocks.
delta.integration: The canonical FREE admission boundary receipt runner now binds both the original boundary suite and the socket-level suite into its source manifest, digests and child execution command.

execution.reason: No authorized local normal-user or clay-direct-dev shell/bridge executor is exposed in this ChatGPT tool surface. Tool absence is infrastructure status, not product failure.
execution.required_next_runtime_gate: Execute tools/run_free_swarm_admission_boundary_receipt.py on exact current source through an exposed authorized zero-cost local or clay-direct-dev executor and preserve exact source/environment/secret/network/result identities.

external_research_fusion.python_audit_hooks: Useful observability layer but Python documentation explicitly says Python-level audit hooks are not a sandbox.
external_research_fusion.linux_network_namespace: A separate Linux network namespace provides OS-level network-stack isolation where the authorized executor has the required capability.
external_research_fusion.recommended_runtime_defense_in_depth: Keep application-level secret/socket counters and, where available without violating authority, add OS-level no-network isolation for blocked-case receipt execution.
